title: Uzbek — BGN/PCGN 2000
authority: BGN/PCGN 2000 Agreement (table checked Nov 2022); supersedes BGN/PCGN 1979
description: BGN/PCGN table of correspondences from former Uzbek Cyrillic to the 1995 Uzbek Latin alphabet, for geographic names. Ў→o‘, Ғ→g‘, Ъ and Ь→’, Ц→ts, Е→ye initially and after vowels, й, ъ, ь.
notes: PCGN prints the modifier as U+2018 (o‘, g‘) and the apostrophe as U+2019; the Uzbek standard prescribes U+02BB and U+02BC (see uz_latin).
Note 1: ye is used initially, after а е ё и о у э ю я ў, and after й, ъ, ь (Судочье → Sudoch’ye).
PCGN says the table should continue to be used despite discussions on altering the official alphabet (the 2026 reform law was unsigned as of 7 Oct 2026).
